digest.component_or_area: Jira Cloud/DC adapter — user identity contract
propositions: PR #120's getattr-based _assignee_resolver was unreachable for DC, causing authoritative to always return False and triggering assignee-diff churn on every pass
A UserIdentityModel protocol with resolve() and to_payload() methods must distinguish Cloud (accountId-based) from DC (name-based) identity resolution with explicit resolver injection
NameIdentity must perform real lookups against DC's user-search endpoint to return authoritative=True and converge diffs, not echo local values with authoritative=False
The 3-state contract (value, authoritative, is_account_id) must be preserved identically across both implementations and tested with parameterized contract tests
Unresolvable assignees must raise BackendAssigneeNotFoundError rather than silently returning non-authoritative values
